text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen drew to a close 
amidst thunderous excitement. Air Groove 
desperately chased down the runaway 
Silence Suzuka and snatched the victory 
for herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Air Groove... found herself 
yearning for Silence Suzuka's overwhelming 
running that drove the fans wild.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unable to overcome the feeling that she 
stood no chance, Air Groove felt a dread 
welling up inside her toward the presence 
known as Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her spirit broken and her composure lost, 
she showed determination toward the 
Sapporo Kinen, only to walk away with 
feeble, unsteady steps.
